notes: Georgia publishes NO committee-only deadline distinct from Crossover Day (Legislative Day 28) — a bill must clear both committee and its chamber's floor by that single date, so committeeCutoffDate/secondCommitteeCutoffDate are left null rather than duplicating crossoverDate under a different label. sineDie (Legislative Day 40, actual/reported = 2026-04-02) conflicts with NCSL's pre-session-projected calendar (which listed 2026-04-06); the ACTUAL date, corroborated by 3+ independent post-session news sources, is used per 'prefer verified actuals over pre-session projections'. convene relies on convergent secondary sources (multistate.us + NCSL) since legis.ga.gov's own calendar is a JS-rendered page that could not be fetched as text — confidence is 'curated' rather than 'high' for this reason.
